hook: Agentic coding, local models, your Mac

beats.say: Localcode is an open source agentic coding tool for the Mac, installed with one command, that runs local models on your own machine.
It uses models like Gemma 4 and Qwen, with speculative drafting to keep coding fast, and its model server ships with precompiled GPU kernels.
Only three features touch the network: model downloads, web search and fetch, and any MCP servers you add.
